pages.text: The file $(thing)config/epicvanguard-common.toml$() lets the server owner change:$(li)recruit cost and XP gain;$(li)warcry cooldown and class chances (critical hit, fury, dodge, taunt);$(li)regeneration, ranged combat, wear and repair, mounts;$(li)Vanguard Point requests and follow distances.$(br2)Values in this book are the defaults.
